name: Jira Issue MCP Server
description: Enables interaction with Jira through OAuth 2.0 to create and manage issues directly from MCP-compatible clients. It supports secure authentication and local token caching to facilitate automated task management within Jira projects.

rawRecord.description: Enables interaction with Jira through OAuth 2.0 to create and manage issues directly from MCP-compatible clients. It supports secure authentication and local token caching to facilitate automated task management within Jira projects.

REDIS_HOST.description: Redis connection string or host:port used for caching tokens. Default: "localhost:6379".

ELASTIC_URL.description: Elastic endpoint URL. Default: not set.

SERVER_DOMAIN.description: Base URL where this server is reachable (used to build OAuth redirect/callback URLs). Default: "http://localhost:3000".

ELASTIC_API_KEY.description: API key for Elastic (used for telemetry/logging if configured). Default: not set.

ATLASSIAN_CLIENT_ID.description: the OAuth client ID from your Atlassian developer app. This and ATLASSIAN_CLIENT_SECRET are mandatory for the OAuth flow to work.

ATLASSIAN_CLIENT_SECRET.description: the OAuth client secret from your Atlassian developer app.
